ENGLISH: Up A Sycamore Tree
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 爬上桑树

ENGLISH: Zacchaeus of Jericho
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 耶利哥的撒该

ENGLISH: A short, rich, lonely man climbs a tree just to see — and comes down carrying a different life.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 一个矮小、富有、孤独的人为了看一眼而爬上树——下来的时候，人生已经不一样了。

ENGLISH: c. AD 30, in Jericho — a rich trade town on the main road east, with a customs post and a Roman garrison.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 约公元 30 年，耶利哥。这是大道上的富庶商镇，有关卡，也驻着罗马兵。

ENGLISH: Zacchaeus is the chief tax collector: he has bought the right to collect Rome's taxes and takes extra for himself. He is rich, hated, and short enough that he cannot see over the crowd.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 撒该是税吏长：他买下了替罗马收税的权利，还从中多收。他有钱，被人恨，个子又矮，站在人群后面什么也看不见。

ENGLISH: Jesus is passing through town, and the crowd will not make room for a collaborator. So Zacchaeus climbs a sycamore. What happens next is not a reward for good behaviour — it is an invitation given before he has changed anything.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 耶稣正从城里经过，人群不会给一个替罗马办事的人让路。撒该只好爬上桑树。接下来发生的事，不是好行为的奖赏，而是一份在他还没改变之前就先给出的邀请。

ENGLISH: Zacchaeus was a chief tax collector — wealthy, collaborating with Rome, and despised by his own town. His offer to repay fourfold goes beyond what the Law required. Jesus does not demand it first; He simply invites Himself to dinner. Grace comes before reformation.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 撒该是税吏长——富有、与罗马合作、被本城人藐视。他愿意四倍偿还，远超律法的要求。但耶稣并没有先要求他这样做，祂只是邀请自己到他家吃饭。恩典先到，改变在后。

ENGLISH: Grace arrived first. Change followed it out of the door.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 恩典先到，改变在后头跟着来。

ENGLISH: Zacchaeus was not asked to clean up before Jesus came to dinner. Being welcomed made him generous. The story insists that real change is a fruit of grace, not a price paid to earn it.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 耶稣去吃饭之前，并没有要求撒该先把自己收拾干净。被接纳，反倒让他慷慨起来。这个故事要说的正是：真正的改变是恩典结出来的果子，不是用来换取恩典的条件。

ENGLISH: What would “restoring fourfold” look like in your own life?
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 在你自己的生命里，「四倍偿还」会是什么样子？

ENGLISH: Returning something I took wrongly
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 归还我不该拿的东西

ENGLISH: Zacchaeus did not just feel sorry, he counted it out. Luke 19:8
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 撒该不只是觉得抱歉，他真把钱一笔一笔数了出来。路加福音 19:8

ENGLISH: Giving more than is expected of me
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 给出超过别人期望的

ENGLISH: Fourfold was beyond the Law. Grace makes people unreasonable in the best way. Luke 19:8
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 四倍，远远超过律法的要求。没有人要求他这样做；恩典常常让人做出不合常理的事。路加福音 19:8

ENGLISH: Welcoming someone nobody else welcomes
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 接纳一个没有人接纳的人

ENGLISH: Jesus ate in the wrong house on purpose. Who is at your table? Luke 19:5
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 耶稣故意进错了家门。今天谁在你的桌旁？路加福音 19:5

ENGLISH: Tap left and right branches in turn to climb before Jesus passes. Miss twice and you slip.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 交替点击左右树枝向上爬，在耶稣经过之前到达树顶。失误两次就会滑落。

ENGLISH: Jericho is packed. Palm branches, dust, shouting, and the particular noise of a crowd that already knows who it dislikes.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 耶利哥挤满了人。棕树枝、尘土、喊声，还有那种人群特有的吵闹——他们早就知道自己讨厌谁。

SPEAKER: crowd
ENGLISH: He is a sinner. A collaborator. He stole from us.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他是个罪人，是替罗马卖命的。他坑过我们的钱。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: There he is — Zacchaeus. Short enough that the crowd is a wall. Watch what he does.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他就在那儿——撒该。个子太矮，人群对他来说就是一堵墙。看他怎么做。

SPEAKER: zacchaeus
ENGLISH: I only want to see Him. Just once. That is all.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 我只想看祂一眼。就一眼。就这样。

ENGLISH: Make a gap in the crowd for him
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 在人群中为他让出一条缝

ENGLISH: Two people move. Then three. The gap lasts about four seconds before it closes again.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 先有两个人让开，接着又是三个。缝隙撑了大约四秒，又合上了。

ENGLISH: Point to the sycamore tree ahead
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 指向前面那棵桑树

ENGLISH: He follows your finger, and his whole face changes. It is not dignified. It is perfect.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他顺着你的手看过去，整张脸都亮了。说不上体面，却刚刚好。

ENGLISH: Ask the crowd why they hate him
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问人群为什么恨他

SPEAKER: crowd
ENGLISH: They list his sins in detail. Nobody mentions his name without spitting first.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他们一条一条数他的罪。没有一个人提起他的名字时不先啐一口。

ENGLISH: A rich man, a chief tax collector, is sitting in a tree like a child. The crowd laughs. He does not care.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 一个财主、一个税吏长，像小孩一样坐在树上。人群在笑。他不在乎。

SPEAKER: jesus
ENGLISH: Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 撒该，快下来！今天我必住在你家里。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Jesus does not say “repay what you stole and then I will come.” He invites Himself first. That order matters.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 耶稣没有说「先把钱还清，我再进你家」。祂先开口要住进去。这个顺序很要紧。

ENGLISH: Help him down from the branch
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 扶他从树枝上下来

ENGLISH: His hands are shaking. He has not been touched kindly in a very long time.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他的手在抖。他已经很久没被人这样碰过了。

ENGLISH: Whisper: “He knows your name”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 轻声说：「祂知道你的名字」

ENGLISH: He climbs down faster than he climbed up. Being known is a powerful thing.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他下树比上树还快。被人认出名字，比什么都管用。

ENGLISH: Look at the crowd’s faces instead
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 转头看人群的表情

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: They are furious. Grace to the wrong person always looks like injustice to somebody.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他们气得脸都变了。恩典落到「不该得的人」身上，在某些人眼里总像是不公平。

SPEAKER: zacchaeus
ENGLISH: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 主啊，我把所有的一半给穷人；我若讹诈了谁，就还他四倍。

ENGLISH: Fourfold. The Law asked for one-fifth extra. Nobody asked him for this. Nobody had to.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 四倍。律法只要求多加五分之一。没有人要求他这样做，也没有人逼他。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: This is what grace does when it is received rather than resisted. It makes a generous person out of a greedy one — without a single instruction.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这就是人接受恩典之后会发生的事：一个贪心的人变得慷慨，没有人下过一道命令。

SPEAKER: servant
ENGLISH: He has never once opened that storeroom before.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这间库房，他从来没打开过。

ENGLISH: Help him carry the coins to the door
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 帮他把钱币搬到门口

ENGLISH: The bags are heavy. He carries the heaviest one himself.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 袋子很沉。最重的那袋，他自己扛。

ENGLISH: Tell the crowd what he just did
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 把刚才的事告诉人群

ENGLISH: Some of them do not believe you. A few go quiet. One woman starts to cry.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 有些人根本不信。有几个人不说话了。一个女人开始哭。

ENGLISH: Ask Jesus why He chose this house
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问耶稣为何选这一家

SPEAKER: jesus
ENGLISH: “For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「人子来，为要寻找拯救失丧的人。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Ten chapters. Ten different ways God walks into an ordinary day and refuses to leave it ordinary.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 十章了。十次不同的经过——神走进平凡的一天，不容它继续平凡下去。

ENGLISH: The dust of Jericho settles. Somewhere, a very short man is counting out coins and smiling.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 耶利哥的尘土落定。某个地方，一个很矮的人正在数钱，一边数一边笑。

ENGLISH: The scroll grows warm in your hands. The road, somehow, is still going.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 书卷在你手里发热。这条路，不知怎么，还在往前。
